title: Gate Passes
readyToDownload: Gate Pass {{n}} is ready to download. OTP approval is separate.
whichPass: Which gate pass do you need?
invoiceHelp: Attach a verified invoice if available — can be added later at goods receipt
noInvoice: No invoice attached — you can create and attach one later if needed.
poItemsTitle: PO Items — expected delivery (actual quantities will be entered at goods receipt)
qtyHelp: Accepted = quantity inspected and posted to inventory. In Transit = approved gate pass but not yet inspected. Expected = remaining quantity to be delivered. Actual delivered quantities will be recorded when creating the goods receipt.
headHelp: A real OTP will be sent to this person's phone via Firebase. They will tell you the OTP.
otpDialogText: An OTP was sent to {{name}} at {{phone}}. Enter the OTP they provide to approve this gate pass. Inventory is updated separately.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete gate pass {{n}}?
deleteNote: This action cannot be undone. Only pending gate passes created by you can be deleted.
firebaseNotConfigured: Firebase is not configured. Cannot send OTP.
createdSending: Gate pass {{n}} created. Sending OTP to {{name}} at {{phone}}...
otpSentMsg: OTP sent to {{name}} at {{phone}}. Get the OTP from them and click "Enter OTP" to approve.
otpFailed: Gate pass created but OTP could not be sent. Click "Enter OTP" then "Resend OTP" to try again.
approvedMsg: Gate pass approved. Inventory has not been updated.
noOtpYet: No OTP has been sent for this gate pass yet. Click "Resend OTP" to send an OTP to the head's phone.
